title: Coercivity of combined boundary integral operators on strongly non-trapping non-convex domains
statement:
For a wide class of strongly non-trapping, possibly non-convex obstacle domains—such as smooth star-shaped domains—does the combined boundary integral operator
\[
A_k=\left(\tfrac12 I+D_k'\right)-ik\eta S_k
\]
retain coercivity at high frequency, perhaps with a mildly degenerating coercivity bound? More specifically, can one prove that there exist constants \(\gamma_0>0\) and possibly \(\alpha>0\) such that, for every family \(v_k\in L^2(\Gamma)\) with \(\|v_k\|_{L^2(\Gamma)}=1\),
\[
\liminf_{k\to\infty}\left|(A_kv_k,v_k)_{L^2(\Gamma)}\right|\ge \gamma_0 k^{-\alpha}?
\]

title: Counting solutions to the power-sum congruence system for a general target tuple
statement:
For a given set of integers $y_1,\ldots,y_n$, determine the number of solutions $(x_1,\ldots,x_n)$ to
$$
\begin{aligned}
x_1+\cdots+x_n&\equiv y_1+\cdots+y_n \pmod N,\\
x_1^2+\cdots+x_n^2&\equiv y_1^2+\cdots+y_n^2 \pmod N,\\
&\ \vdots\\
x_1^n+\cdots+x_n^n&\equiv y_1^n+\cdots+y_n^n \pmod N.
\end{aligned}
$$
The report states that this is currently not known in general.
references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/34](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15577), page 57. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.
